en.topic_title: Suicide rate among children under 15 tripled last year, as researchers urge schools and media to do better
en.topic_summary:
A university research centre has urged schools to strengthen mental health awareness among students after statistics revealed a rise in the suicide rate for children under 15 last year.



A man sits on a bench in Hong Kong. File photo: GovHK. 



The Hong Kong Jockey Club Centre for Suicide Research and Prevention at the University of Hong Kong announced the city’s latest suicide statistics on Thursday.
